title: baliospermum calycinum var. effusum
intro: Baliospermum calycinum var. effusum, commonly known as Wild Bitter Cucumber, is a plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Baliospermum calycinum var. effusum include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
